payload.summary: PR #360 merged the reviewed planning artifacts by rebase. All 33 unchecked implementation tasks were migrated to followup-add-prime-agent-harness with their design, contracts, spec deltas, dependencies, and file scopes intact. The original change is approved for archival without canonical spec promotion because no implementation or production rollout occurred.

decisions.title: Migrate all open work to a follow-up OpenSpec proposal
decisions.rationale: The entire implementation remained open, so a follow-up proposal preserves executable planning context better than flattening the work into issue summaries.

decisions.title: Archive without canonical spec promotion
decisions.rationale: The copied deltas describe unimplemented behavior and remain owned by the follow-up proposal; promoting them during cleanup would misstate implementation reality.

decisions.title: Treat staged rollout as not applicable
decisions.rationale: PR #360 contained planning artifacts only and deployed no runtime behavior, feature flag, traffic shift, or production artifact.

next_steps: archive add-prime-agent-harness with spec promotion skipped

relevant_files.description: Approved successor proposal containing all unimplemented work
